lines.en: I walk into the living room to be greeted by an unfamiliar, ear-piercing sound...
lines.zh: 我走进客厅，迎面撞上一个陌生又刺耳的声音……

lines.en: Apparently, Ami has decided that it is acceptable to blast music in her room at 9:00 in the morning.
lines.zh: 显然，Ami 已经认定：早上九点在房间里放爆音音乐是完全可以接受的。

lines.en: I’m already awake, so it’s not really as big of a deal as it could have been...but it’s still too early to deal with something like this.
lines.zh: 反正我已经醒了，所以事情不算能有多糟就有多糟……但处理这种事，现在还是太早了点。

lines.en: : Ami...can you turn that down a little please?
lines.zh: : Ami……能把音量调小一点吗，拜托？

lines.en: : Mmm mmm hmmm...mmm hmmm hmmmmmm...
lines.zh: : 嗯 嗯 唔……嗯 唔 唔嗯嗯……

lines.en: She either ignores or simply doesn't hear my request as she happily hums away at whatever song is playing behind the door.
lines.zh: 她要么是故意无视，要么压根没听见我的请求，隔着门开心地哼着不知什么歌。

lines.en: : Ami, come on. It's way too early for this.
lines.zh: : Ami，拜托。现在也太早了。

lines.en: : Hmmm hmmm hmmmm...mmm mm mm mmm mmm...
lines.zh: : 唔 唔 唔嗯……嗯 嗯 嗯 唔 唔……

lines.en: Is this what it means to be the guardian of a [teenage]girl?
lines.zh: 这就是给一个 [teenage] 女孩当监护人的滋味吗？

lines.en: It pains me to know that there are families out there with more than one of these things.
lines.zh: 一想到世上还有家里养着不止一个这种生物的，我就心痛。

lines.en: Ami’s well-behaved and cute and all that, but even I don’t know if I’d be able to deal with waking up to two of her.
lines.zh: Ami 算是乖巧又可爱什么的了，但连我也不知道，要是每天醒来面对两个她，我受不受得了。

lines.en: Though...I guess it wouldn't be right to ignore the prospective benefits of something like that as well.
lines.zh: 话虽如此……这种事潜在的好处，好像也不该视而不见。

lines.en: You know what? Fuck it.
lines.zh: 管他的。豁出去了。

lines.en: This is my house and I have the right to barge into her room if she's not going to respond to me.
lines.zh: 这是我的房子，她既然不理我，我就有权闯进她的房间。

lines.en: And if the worst (or best) case scenario happens and I end up walking in on something I shouldn't see, I can always just ask for forgiveness.
lines.zh: 就算最糟（或最好）的情况发生，我真撞见了不该看的东西，事后请求原谅就是了。

lines.en: Especially considering that asking for permission was entirely fruitless.
lines.zh: 毕竟，征求同意已经彻底无效了。

lines.en: : Ah-
And of course she's in her underwear. Who could have predicted such a thing?
lines.zh: 而她当然只穿着内衣。谁能料到这种事呢？

lines.en: : You're either going to go deaf or get us evicted if you don't turn that music down, you know.
lines.zh: : 你再不把音乐调小，不是聋掉就是害我们被赶出去，知道吗。

lines.en: : Oh. Um. Uhh. I'm sorry.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯。呃。对不起。

lines.en: : I just...really like this song and wasn't paying attention to you knocking on the door.
lines.zh: : 我就是……特别喜欢这首歌，没注意到你在敲门。

lines.en: : Doesn't that sentence kind of imply that you knew I was knocking?
lines.zh: : 这话听起来，是不是等于承认你其实知道我在敲门？

lines.en: : No?
lines.zh: : 没有吗？

lines.en: Ami looks away, not recoiling in the type of way you'd expect an embarrassed teenage girl to do at a time like this.
lines.zh: Ami 把视线移开，却没有像一般害臊的女高中生在这个时刻该做的那样慌张退缩。

lines.en: She tugs on her twintails to tighten them, keeping her eyes locked on where her walls meet her ceiling as if she's intentionally providing an opportunity for me to inspect her body.
lines.zh: 她拽了拽双马尾把发束收紧，眼睛直勾勾盯住墙壁与天花板交界的地方，仿佛在刻意给我一个端详她身体的机会。

lines.en: Not that there's much to inspect in the first place, seeing as I have a hard time believing she's developed at all over the last few years.
lines.zh: 也谈不上有什么好端详的——过去这几年她到底发育了没有，我都很难相信。

lines.en: Even with this, though, the allure of her petite frame and the slenderness of her limbs force thoughts I should not be having into my head.
lines.zh: 即便如此，她娇小的身形与纤细的四肢仍带着一种魅力，硬把那些我本不该有的念头塞进我脑子里。

lines.en: And instead of trying to protect me from them, it's like she's the one holding my hair back and getting me to swallow the pill.
lines.zh: 而她非但没有替我挡开这些念头，反倒像是按着我后脑、逼我把药丸吞下去的人。

lines.en: : So...umm...
: I guess I'll...maybe...pay a little more attention next time you knock?
lines.zh: : 我下次……大概……会在你敲门时多留意一点的？

lines.en: : I'm starting to think you might have wanted me to walk in on you in this state.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得，你是不是就希望我在这种状态下撞进来。

lines.en: : Th...This might not sound believable, but that's really not what I was trying to do!
lines.zh: : 听、听起来可能不太可信，但我真的不是故意那样做的！

lines.en: : B-B-Besides! It’s not like I’m totally naked or anything. You've...seen me in my bra plenty of times before.
lines.zh: : 而、而且！我又不是全裸什么的。你之前……见过我穿胸罩的次数多了去了。

lines.en: : Honestly, you can walk around the house in nothing but this for all I care.
lines.zh: : 说实话，你要想就穿这一身在家里晃，我完全没意见。

lines.en: In fact, I endorse it. But I'm not about to just come out and tell her that until I'm a little more...confident that she's fine with it too.
lines.zh: 事实上，我举双手赞成。但在更有把握确认她自己也乐意之前，我不会把这话明说出口。

lines.en: : I really do just want the music turned down.
lines.zh: : 我是真的只想让你把音乐调小。

lines.en: : Can you at least pretend to be a little taken aback by walking in on me in the middle of getting changed?
lines.zh: : 你能不能至少装一下撞见我换衣服时的吃惊？

lines.en: : Why would I do that when you literally just mentioned that this has happened tons of times before?
lines.zh: : 你刚刚才说过这种事发生过无数次，我装什么劲？

lines.en: : It has, but that doesn’t mean we shouldn't still be a little embarrassed about it...
lines.zh: : 是发生过，但这不代表我们不该为此害羞一下……

lines.en: : We might be related, but we're still opposite sexes and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我们就算有血缘，也还是异性什么的呀。

lines.en: : I'll tell you what...Start growing a little more and then I will act embarrassed after walking in on you.
lines.zh: : 这样好了……你再多发育一点，我以后撞见你时就装出害羞的样子。

lines.en: : Because as it stands, this is barely any different from walking in on a-
lines.zh: : 因为照现在这样，我撞见的跟撞见一个——

lines.en: : Finish that sentence and I will murder you! You know I'm sensitive about that!
lines.zh: : 这句话你敢说完我就杀了你！你知道我在意那个的！

lines.en: : It's all in good fun. I like your body the way it is and I can't really imagine it being any other way.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。我喜欢你身体本来的样子，我根本想象不了它变成别的样子。

lines.en: : I'd also be extremely concerned and confused if you managed to go up several sizes overnight, so don't worry about how quickly you're growing or whatever.
lines.zh: : 而且你要是一夜之间大上好几号，我反而会相当担心加困惑。所以发育快慢什么的，别放在心上。

lines.en: : You're...really okay with me looking like this?
lines.zh: : 我长这样……你真的不介意？

lines.en: : You don't think I'm too, like...childish or something?
lines.zh: : 你不觉得我太……小孩子气什么的吗？

lines.en: : Are you asking me that as my niece? Or as a student?
lines.zh: : 你是以侄女的身份问我？还是以学生的身份？

lines.en: : Is there a third option that makes you sound like less of a predator?
lines.zh: : 有没有第三个选项，能让你听起来不那么像变态？

lines.en: : I'm sure there is, but I couldn't really think of it.
lines.zh: : 肯定有，但我一时想不出来。

lines.en: : Maybe...as a girl? Despite my lack of development in...certain areas...I'm still one of those, you know.
lines.zh: : 那……以一个女孩的身份？虽然在某些……部位上发育欠佳……但我仍然是其中之一，你知道的吧。

lines.en: : As a girl, I think you're plenty beautiful.
lines.zh: : 以一个女孩来说，我觉得你相当漂亮。

lines.en: : Hah...hahah...
: I know I asked for that, but...it's still a little embarrassing to hear you say it out loud.
lines.zh: : 我知道是我自己要你说的，但……你大声讲出来还是有点让人害臊。

lines.en: She looks away yet again, puffing out what little exists of her chest as if to show me that there is something there.
lines.zh: 她又一次移开视线，微微挺起那几近于无的胸口，仿佛要让我看到那里确实有些什么。

lines.en: Something she wants me to see despite the gaps in both age and power between us- like a cat in heat presenting herself to a prospective mate.
lines.zh: 明明我们之间隔着年龄与力量的鸿沟，她却执意要我看——像发情的猫，把自己呈给未来的伴侣。

lines.en: She pokes at the soft, pliable flesh of her left cheek, tempting me to step forward and take her face in my hands to see just how soft and pliable she really is.
lines.zh: 她用指尖戳着自己左脸柔软的肌肤，引诱我上前一步、用双手捧住她的脸，试试她到底有多软。

lines.en: Just how long is she going to invite me to observe her for?
lines.zh: 她还要邀请我端详她多久？

lines.en: And just what is she trying to get out of this?
lines.zh: 她究竟想从这里面得到什么？

lines.en: : Stay exactly as you are, Ami. As my niece, my student, and a girl.
lines.zh: : 保持现在的样子就好，Ami。作为我的侄女、我的学生，和一个女孩。

lines.en: : If I didn’t know any better...I’d think you were trying to flirt with me right now.
lines.zh: : 要不是我了解你……我会以为你是在跟我调情。

lines.en: Ami laughs nervously, but her gaze does not depart from whichever spot on her desk she's locked onto.
lines.zh: Ami 紧张地笑了笑，目光却仍锁在桌上某个点，一步不挪。

lines.en: : And if I didn’t know any better, I’d think you want me to flirt with you.
lines.zh: : 要是我也不了解你，我会以为你巴不得我跟你调情。

lines.en: : As your niece? Or as a student?
lines.zh: : 以侄女的身份？还是以学生的身份？

lines.en: : Is there a third option that doesn't make it sound like you're trying to entrap me?
lines.zh: : 有没有第三个选项，听起来不像在设局套我？

lines.en: : Maybe I do want to entrap you? Have you ever thought about that?
lines.zh: : 说不定我就是想套你呢？你想过这个可能吗？

lines.en: I've been thinking of that this entire time. But the longer my gaze remains fixated on her pubescent body, the deeper my hole of depravity becomes.
lines.zh: 这正是我从头到尾在想的事。只是我的目光在她青春期初绽的身体上停留得越久，我堕落的深渊就越深。

lines.en: : Are you trying to seduce me right now, Ami?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在勾引我吗，Ami？

lines.en: : Seduce? Me? Yeah, as if I could even do that in the first place.
lines.zh: : 勾引？我？哈，我哪有那种本事。

lines.en: : Don’t you need to be, like...sexy in order to seduce someone?
lines.zh: : 勾引人不是得……性感什么的才行吗？

lines.en: : Innocence is as powerful a tool as any in the world of seduction.
lines.zh: : 在勾引的世界里，天真无邪不输任何武器。

lines.en: In fact, it's even more powerful for those of us who are already halfway buried.
lines.zh: 事实上，对我们这种已经半截入土的人来说，它反而更致命。

lines.en: : Is that...so?
lines.zh: : 是……这样吗？

lines.en: : Then I guess it's...kind of dangerous that I still haven't put my shirt on...huh?
lines.zh: : 那我到现在……还没把上衣穿回去……好像挺危险的，哈？

lines.en: Despite what sounds like a warning or a suggestion, something tells me that Ami has no intention of covering up.
lines.zh: 尽管听起来像警告或提醒，但我有种预感：Ami 根本没有遮起来的打算。

lines.en: And I have no intention of asking her to. Especially since I've all but confirmed at this point that this really was a calculated move on her part.
lines.zh: 而我也没有开口的打算。毕竟到这一步，我基本已经确认：这从头到尾都是她的算计。

lines.en: All the while my thoughts run rampant, the voice of who I imagine is a beautiful girl carries throughout the room.
lines.zh: 就在我的念头四处狂奔时，那个我臆想中的美丽女孩的嗓音，仍在房间里回荡。

lines.en: I wonder if she is as beautiful as this one?
lines.zh: 她是否也和眼前这位一样美？

lines.en: : Why...do you think innocence is so powerful, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 为什么……你觉得天真无邪有那么强大的力量，Sensei？

lines.en: : I guess there are just a lot of people out there who take pride in getting to see something that no one else ever has.
lines.zh: : 大概因为，世上就是有很多人以「看到了别人从未看到的东西」为荣。

lines.en: : Are you...taking pride in that right now, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你现在……就在为此感到得意吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Because no one else has ever seen me like this...And no one else probably will ever see me like this.
lines.zh: : 因为从来没有别人见过我这样……以后大概也不会有。

lines.en: : That can't be true, Ami.
lines.zh: : 不可能是这样的，Ami。

lines.en: : Are you saying you'd be okay with someone else seeing me like this?
lines.zh: : 你的意思是，别人看到我这样你也无所谓？

lines.en: : I'm saying it's not up to me to decide who you can and can't show yourself off to.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，你能给谁看、不能给谁看，轮不到我来决定。

lines.en: : Okay, but...
lines.zh: : 好吧，可是……

lines.en: : What if I say it is up to you?
lines.zh: : 要是我说，就由你决定呢？

lines.en: The temptation to take things further with my niece somehow overtakes the mysterious girl's singing voice as the loudest thing inside of my head.
lines.zh: 与侄女更进一步的那种诱惑，不知何时压过了神秘女孩的歌声，成了我脑海中最响的声音。

lines.en: I attempt to fight it off in an effort to prevent her from joining me in the hole, but I am losing the battle and she is not letting up.
lines.zh: 我试图把它赶出去，免得她跟着我一起坠进深渊——但我节节败退，而她步步紧逼。

lines.en: : J...Just because you're my guardian, I mean. And you will be for...a while longer, so...
lines.zh: : 就……就是说，你是我的监护人嘛。而且你还要当……好一阵子，所以……

lines.en: : So I kind of have to do what you tell me to. You know?
lines.zh: : 所以你说什么，我多少都得照做。你懂的吧？

lines.en: : If I told you to take off the rest of your clothes, would you do that?
lines.zh: : 要是我叫你把剩下的衣服也脱了，你会照做吗？

lines.en: : Do you want me to do that?...
lines.zh: : 你想让我那么做吗？……

lines.en: : Maybe. Or maybe I'm just trying to figure out exactly what family means to you.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。又或者，我只是想弄清楚，「家人」对你来说到底意味着什么。

lines.en: : What...family means to me...
lines.zh: : 「家人」……对我来说……

lines.en: Ami looks away again, but things are different this time.
lines.zh: Ami 又一次移开视线，但这次不一样了。

lines.en: The inarguable sexual tension that filled the space between us over the last few minutes disperses and leaves nothing but the faint scent of longing as Ami's mind wraps around itself.
lines.zh: 过去几分钟里充斥在我们之间、无可辩驳的情欲张力四散而去，只剩一缕稀薄的渴望气息——Ami 的思绪开始缠住她自己。

lines.en: I just asked a girl with one remaining family member what family means to her.
lines.zh: 我刚刚问了一个亲人只剩一个的女孩：家人对她意味着什么。

lines.en: Will she respond with something akin to loss? Will she provide a lengthy description of her feelings on the matter with sorrow oozing out of every negative adjective?
lines.zh: 她的回答会带着类似「失去」的东西吗？她会用长长的篇幅描述感受，让每个贬义词都渗出悲伤吗？

lines.en: Or will her words be more callous than that?
lines.zh: 还是说，她的话语会比这更冷硬？

lines.en: Perhaps she's already given up on the idea of family? Perhaps she's-
lines.zh: 也许她早已放弃「家人」这个概念？也许她——

lines.en: : You're a pretty big pervert...aren't you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你是个不折不扣的变态……对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: Or perhaps she'll miraculously find her way out of this predicament without showing me a new side of her metaphysical self at all.
lines.zh: 又或者，她能奇迹般地脱身，压根不让我看到她灵魂深处的另一面。

lines.en: Perhaps she is smarter than she presents herself.
lines.zh: 也许她比她表现出来的聪明得多。

lines.en: : I guess I am.
lines.zh: : 我猜是的。

lines.en: : I'm so much of a pervert that I can't even stop myself from flirting with my niece after barging into her room.
lines.zh: : 我变态到闯进侄女房间之后，连和自己侄女调情都停不下来。

lines.en: : Luckily for you, I am the world's greatest niece. So I'll forgive you and let you flirt with me as much as you want.
lines.zh: : 好在你运气不错，我是全世界最好的侄女。所以我原谅你，还允许你想怎么调情就怎么调情。

lines.en: : You are a boy after all. It's only natural that you'd want to flirt with any half-naked girl who appears before you.
lines.zh: : 你毕竟是男生嘛。眼前一出现半裸的女孩就想调情，再正常不过了。

lines.en: : But don't go taking that as permission for you to surround yourself with other half-naked girls because I still want you all to myself, you know?
lines.zh: : 但你可别把这当成许可，跑去和别的半裸女孩厮混——我还是要独占你的，知道吗？

lines.en: : Which means that I guess I'll just have to stand in for all of the others that you're missing out on and-
lines.zh: : 也就是说，那些你错过的其他女孩，看来只好由我一人代劳，而且——

lines.en: : Ah-
Somehow or another, I wind up on top of Ami.
lines.zh: 不知怎么搞的，我最后把 Ami 压在了身下。

lines.en: It's unclear whether I threw her here or if she climbed onto the bed herself, but the mild shock reflected in her pupils tells me it's something closer to the former.
lines.zh: 说不清是我把她推倒在床上，还是她自己爬了上去；但她瞳孔里映出的轻微惊愕告诉我，多半是前者。

lines.en: Even with that, though, she makes no attempt to push me off of her.
lines.zh: 即便如此，她也没有半点想把我推开的动作。

lines.en: We remain still, staring into each other's eyes, and I wonder what it is that she sees reflected in mine.
lines.zh: 我们静止不动，彼此凝视。我不知道她在我眼中看到了什么。

lines.en: Is it truly perversion like she suggested just moments ago?
lines.zh: 真是她刚才说的那种变态吗？

lines.en: Or is it something darker?
lines.zh: 还是更黑暗的东西？

lines.en: Can she see the person I truly am? The same person who replaced her beloved Sensei without her so much as noticing?
lines.zh: 她能看见真正的我吗？那个把她深爱的 Sensei 神不知鬼不觉换掉的人？

lines.en: No...
No, he couldn't be that beloved. For if he was, my presence would not have gone unnoted.
lines.zh: 不，他不可能那么被深爱。否则，我的存在不会无人察觉。

lines.en: This isn't my real niece. She's just a body.
lines.zh: 这不是我的真侄女。她只是一具身体。

lines.en: A small, attractive, developing body...but a body nonetheless.
lines.zh: 一具娇小的、有魅力的、正在发育的身体……但终究只是一具身体。

lines.en: And I can take her whenever I want without any consequences at all.
lines.zh: 而我随时可以要了她，不用承担任何后果。

lines.en: So what exactly is the cause for this momentary bout of hesitation?
lines.zh: 那么，这一瞬的踌躇，究竟从何而来？

lines.en: Why are the rest of her clothes still on?
lines.zh: 为什么她剩下的衣服还穿着？

lines.en: And why do I not want to get up?
lines.zh: 又为什么，我不想起来？

lines.en: : Go ahead.
lines.zh: : 动手吧。

lines.en: : Go ahead with what?
lines.zh: : 动什么手？

lines.en: : You tell me, Sensei. You're the one who pushed me down. And before I could even finish getting dressed, too.
lines.zh: : 你说呢，Sensei。把我按倒的是你。而且还是在我衣服都没换完的时候。

lines.en: : You really are a pervert, aren't you?
lines.zh: : 你真是个变态，对吧？

lines.en: : Just be careful since you're on my hair. If you do anything to mess it up or pull any out, I'll be forced to fight back.
lines.zh: : 不过小心点，你压到我头发了。你要是敢弄乱它、或者扯掉一根，我就只能反击了。

lines.en: : Do you really think you'd have a chance against me in a fight?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得自己打得过我？

lines.en: : Probably not, but that doesn't mean I wouldn't try.
lines.zh: : 多半打不过，但这不代表我不会试。

lines.en: : I think I'd like to see that.
lines.zh: : 那我还挺想看看的。

lines.en: : Are you really challenging me after you've already got me in this position? Isn't that a little unfair, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 都把我压成这样了还向我挑战？这是不是有点不公平，Sensei？

lines.en: : Yeah, well...life is unfair.
lines.zh: : 是啊……人生本来就不公平。

lines.en: : It really is, isn't it?
lines.zh: : 真是不公平呢，对吧？

lines.en: So much time passes without either one of us attempting to escape, which makes it clear that neither of us wants to.
lines.zh: 很久过去，谁都没有试图逃开——这足以说明，我们谁都不想。

lines.en: Or perhaps we do-
lines.zh: 又或者，我们是想逃的——

lines.en: But there is just nowhere else to go.
lines.zh: 只是，实在无处可去。

lines.en: : Sensei...if you stay on top of me any longer...I might get the wrong idea.
lines.zh: : Sensei……你要是再继续压着我……我可能会想歪哦。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you don’t have the wrong idea already.
lines.zh: : 你居然还没想歪，我反倒惊讶。

lines.en: : Maybe I do. But I know you won't hurt me.
lines.zh: : 说不定已经想歪了。但我知道，你不会伤害我。

lines.en: : After all, you’d never do anything to-
lines.zh: : 毕竟，你绝对不会对我——

lines.en: : Ah!
: How can you be so sure I wouldn't do anything to hurt you?
lines.zh: : 你怎么就那么肯定，我不会伤害你？

lines.en: : Have...your hands always been this big? They fit around my entire forearm.
lines.zh: : 你的手……一直这么大吗？整条前臂都能握进去。

lines.en: : Answer the question, Ami.
lines.zh: : 回答问题，Ami。

lines.en: : About how you won't hurt me?
lines.zh: : 关于你不会伤害我？

lines.en: : Yes. How do you know that? Why do you sound so sure?
lines.zh: : 对。你怎么知道的？为什么说得那么肯定？

lines.en: : Because...
lines.zh: : 因为……

lines.en: : Because we're family...
lines.zh: : 因为我们是家人……

lines.en: : And because I'm one of the only things in this world that you're actually attached to.
lines.zh: : 还因为，这个世界上你真正牵挂的东西，屈指可数，而我是其中之一。

lines.en: : You and me don't hurt one another. It's not who we are.
lines.zh: : 你和我不会互相伤害。那不是我们的样子。

lines.en: : I don't even know if we can hurt one another. I don't think our bodies...or our minds would let that happen.
lines.zh: : 我甚至不知道我们能不能伤害到彼此。我们的身体……还有心，都不会允许那种事发生。

lines.en: : So you can do whatever you want to me and I'll be sure to look up at you...
lines.zh: : 所以你想对我做什么都可以，我一定会仰头看着你……

lines.en: : Smiling the whole time.
lines.zh: : 从头到尾，都笑着。

lines.en: : Hah...
: Huh?
: What?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : Where are you going?
lines.zh: : 你去哪？

lines.en: : Are you done already? Nothing even-
lines.zh: : 这就结束了？明明什么都还没有——

lines.en: : Turn the music down, Ami.
lines.zh: : 把音乐调小，Ami。

lines.en: : Wait...But...
lines.zh: : 等等……可是……

lines.en: : Hold on. Is that really all that's going to happen?
lines.zh: : 等一下。真的就这样了吗？

lines.en: : Even after we-
lines.zh: : 明明我们都已经——

lines.en: : That's all that's going to happen.
lines.zh: : 就这样了。

lines.en: : I have other stuff I have to do today anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我今天还有别的事要办。

lines.en: I get off of Ami and make my way to the door.
lines.zh: 我从 Ami 身上起来，朝门口走去。

lines.en: : I’ll make breakfast today. You can come out whenever you're ready.
lines.zh: : 今天早饭我来做。你准备好了随时出来。

lines.en: : Do you have a shirt? Or do you need me to get you one out of the dryer?
lines.zh: : 你有上衣吗？还是需要我从烘干机里帮你拿一件？

lines.en: : I have one...
lines.zh: : 我有……

lines.en: : Good.
lines.zh: : 那就好。

lines.en: : I'll see you in a few minutes then.
lines.zh: : 那几分钟后见。

lines.en: : What...
lines.zh: : 什么……

lines.en: : What the heck just happened?...
lines.zh: : 刚才到底……发生了什么？……

lines.en: Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]！
